settings.description: Themes, the default look of the application, the landing app per role and how each application looks. Organisation branding (logo, primary colour) applies in every theme.
settings.allowUserTheme: Allow users to choose their theme
settings.allowUserThemeHint: Off: everyone uses the default theme. On: users pick one of the available themes in their profile.

settings.brandingNote: The logo and primary colour from Branding apply in every theme.
settings.landingDescription: Users holding the role land on the app when they open the application (Enterprise and Modern themes). The first matching rule wins; a user's own default app comes first.
settings.noRules: No rules: users land on My Work.
settings.appsDescription: Display name, icon, accent colour, tabs and the home dashboard of each application (Enterprise and Modern themes). Changes never give anyone access.
settings.lowContrast: White icons on this colour have a contrast of {{ratio}} : 1; choose a darker colour (at least 3 : 1).
